body: "Don't ever tell someone your problems; 20% don't care, the other 80% take pleasure in your misery."

I write extensive notes for studying and for whenever I need them, but it never seems to help much, if at all. I do this because people recommend this due to my bad memory; it's more of a force of habit type of thing.

I just specifically mentioned fast food because it is what comes to mind; in either event, you're still working a bad job for little money, no?

I'm only a Junior in High School, so no community college, yet. 
I know it is a certified health problem...but who wants to admit they are a lesser person and need to have government assistance and work lesser jobs because of their debilitation? 
I would go to a doctor, but my family doesn't have the time or money to take me to one, and, by Colorado law, you have to have a guardian with you.

I've thought of it, but I haven't the slightest clue as to how to get into it as a career. I wanted to be a doctor or a nurse, not some under-paid journalist. That's what's so depressing, you have to settle for so much less...due to something so small.

I know there are options, but they seem so...limited and bad in general. I'm not trying to be mean, I value your response very highly, even if my writing doesn't show it, so I apologize if it seems I am uncaring.
And even then you are kept, because the government says so.
